messages.subject: Rattle 2.6.17 and PMML 1.2.29 Released
parts:
New versions of Rattle and PMML have been released and are now on the master CRAN node and propagating through CRAN. 

Start up R and: 

> install.packages(c("rattle", "pmml")) 

The major update has been support for exporting randomForest models as PMML, with thanks to Tridivesh Jena of Zementis.com

Other updates include:

  * Add a log10 transform. Suggested by Christophe Klopp.
  
  * Bug fix usage of believeNRows in ODBC. Reported by Andrew Elliott.
  
  * Add ggplot2 box plots to Advanced Graphics option.
  
A full change log is available as
 
  http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rattle/ChangeLog 

As always feedback, comments, suggestions (with R code is good) are always welcome. 

Regards,
Graham
